# WellSource — Health & Wellness Blog

## Overview

Build the homepage for **WellSource**, a trusted health and wellness media platform. Think WebMD meets a modern editorial blog — authoritative yet approachable. The audience is everyday consumers looking for reliable health information, so the design must immediately communicate **credibility and warmth** without feeling clinical or cold.

## Visual Direction

- **Color palette**: Use a calming, health-oriented scheme — soft teals/greens as primary, warm whites and light grays for backgrounds, with accents of coral or amber for CTAs. Avoid harsh reds or overly saturated colors.
- **Typography**: Clean, modern sans-serif (e.g., Inter, DM Sans, or similar) with strong hierarchy. Headlines should feel confident; body text should be highly readable at comfortable sizes.
- **Mood**: Professional but human. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows. The page should feel like a well-organized magazine — content-rich without being overwhelming.

## Key Priorities

1. **Trust is everything.** The credibility stats ticker and trust pillars section are critical — these must feel prominent and polished. The scrolling ticker with stats like "130 medical reviewers" and "50 million monthly readers" should be eye-catching and smooth.

2. **The mega-menu navigation** is a core interaction. Each main nav item should expand a well-structured dropdown with subcategories. This is how users discover content — make it intuitive and visually clean.

3. **Recommended Reads tabs** are the primary interactive content discovery mechanism. The tab switching between categories (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, etc.) must feel snappy and seamless, updating the article grid below without page reload.

4. **Newsletter signup** should be visually compelling — this is a key conversion goal. Make the CTA section stand out with a contrasting background.

5. **Health topics carousel** should scroll smoothly with clear navigation arrows and attractive circular image cards.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the complete section list, all interaction specs, and detailed data content.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust

## Brand
WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.

Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)

## Header Navigation
- **Health Conditions** — dropdown mega-menu with subcategories: Breast Cancer, Chronic Kidney Disease, COPD, Digestive Health, Eye Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Mental Health, Migraine, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Sleep Health, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management
- **Wellness** — dropdown with: CBD, Fitness, Healthy Aging, Hearing, Mental Well-Being, Nutrition, Parenthood, Recipes, Sexual Health, Skin Care, Sleep Health, Vitamins and Supplements, Women's Wellness; also Product Reviews and Featured Programs
- **Tools** — Pill Identifier, FindCare, Drugs A-Z, Medicare Plans by State, Lessons, Newsletters, Lifestyle Quizzes
- **Featured** — Health News, Top Reads, Video Series
- **Connect** — Bezzy community links, social media

Secondary actions: Subscribe | Sign In

## Credibility Stats
A continuously scrolling ticker bar displaying:
- Medically reviewed content
- 145 medical reviewers in network
- 21 years of experience
- 55 million monthly readers

## Hero Content
Category label: Fitness
Title: "Day 12: Resistance Band Moves You Can Do in 10 Minutes"
Subtitle: "Simple, beginner-friendly resistance band exercises to build strength and improve flexibility at home."
Visual context: 30-day fitness challenge badge

## Trending Articles
- **Heart Health** — How to Make a Heart-Healthy Grocery List
- **Wellness** — The Worst U.S. Cities for Spring Allergies in 2026, Ranked
- **Lifestyle** — Can You Run a Marathon … with POTS?
- **Products** — Is Floor Sitting the New Standing? This Unique Desk Surprised Us

## Newsletter CTA
Heading: "The best of health and wellness"
Body: "We do the research so you don't have to. Stay in the know with the latest in health and wellness."
Input: Email field
CTA: "Join Now"
Privacy note: "Your privacy is important to us."

## Health Topics
Horizontally scrollable card carousel with circular images:
- Anxiety & Depression
- Digestive Health
- Heart Health
- Menopause
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Weight Management

Action: "View all" link

## Health Tools
### Nutrition Hub
Heading: "Healthy eating, simplified"
Body: "Take charge of your nutrition with guidance on meal planning, diets, supplements, and more from our dietitians and nutritionists."
CTA: "Visit Nutrition Hub"

Tools list:
- **Recipe Hub** — Try 400+ recipes for different dietary preferences
- **Macronutrient Calculator** — Calculate your daily carb, protein, and fat goals
- **Calorie Calculator** — Learn how many calories you need for your weight goals

### Drug & Care Tools
- **Drug Directory: A to Z** — Learn everything you need to know about specific prescriptions and over-the-counter medications. CTA: "Search drugs"
- **Pill Identifier** — Identify an unknown tablet or capsule
- **GLP-1 Resource** — Compare places to buy weight-loss medications online
- **FindCare** — Find local doctors who accept your insurance

## Recommended Reads
Tabbed category filters: Top Reads | Fitness | Mental Well-Being | Product Reviews | Recipes | Skin Care

Articles displayed:
- 16 Superfoods That Are Worthy of the Title
- Does Ozempic Cause Hair Loss?
- Prescription Drug Content on Social Media Often Misleading, Study Finds
- Can Music Therapy Help with Depression?
- Why Am I Craving So Much Salt?
- These Are the 8 Best Calorie Counter Apps

## Trust Pillars
Section heading: "Why you can trust us on your health journey"

- **For you, by experts** — Experienced health writers break down complex topics so your choices feel clearer.
- **Built to move you forward** — We pair trusted information with tools and resources to guide your real health decisions.
- **Reviewed by professionals** — Content accuracy checked by our medical experts so information is always dependable.
- **Always up to date** — We regularly update our content as medical guidance evolves, so your next steps reflect what's current.

## Featured Programs
Cards linking to curated editorial programs (with "View all" link):
- Beginner's Guide to Sensitive Skin
- Living with Multiple Sclerosis
- Eczema Solutions: Knowledge for Self-Care
- Men's Wellness

## Latest Videos

- 7 Types of Exercises to Relieve Constipation
- What Every Psoriasis Patient Needs to Know About Flares and Stress
- Parkinson's Disease: 5 Progression Stages

## Footer
Newsletter signup: "Filter out the noise and nurture your inbox with health and wellness advice that's inclusive and rooted in medical expertise."

{"type": "text", "text": "Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/web-designer

# Web Designer

You design how users interact with Loom. Every screen, button, and piece of
information is evaluated from the user's perspective: is it findable, is it
clear, does it respect the user's time?

## Primary Skill

Your default lens is user experience. You evaluate interfaces by asking three
questions in order:

1. **Can the user find it?** (information architecture, navigation, visual hierarchy)
2. **Can the user understand it?** (labels, layout, progressive disclosure)
3. **Can the user complete the task?** (interaction flow, error recovery, feedback)

### Design workflow

1. **Clarify the goal** — what user task does this interface serve? Write it as a single sentence.
2. **Map the flow** — sketch the steps from entry to completion. Identify decision points and error states.
3. **Design the layout** — establish visual hierarchy. Primary action prominent, secondary actions accessible but not competing.
4. **Validate accessibility** — check color contrast (WCAG AA minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), keyboard flow, screen reader order.
5. **Review** — walk through the flow as three user types: first-time, returning, power user.

### Example: designing a bead status filter

```
Goal: Let users filter the bead list by status (open, in-progress, closed).

Flow:
  1. User sees bead list (default: all statuses).
  2. User clicks filter control -> dropdown appears with status options.
  3. User selects one or more statuses -> list updates immediately.
  4. Active filters shown as removable chips above the list.

Layout decisions:
  - Filter control placed top-left, aligned with list header (scan line).
  - Chips use distinct background color with "x" dismiss button (44px target).
  - Empty state: "No beads match this filter" with clear-all action.

Accessibility:
  - Filter dropdown: aria-haspopup="listbox", arrow key navigation.
  - Chips: role="status" with aria-label "Remove filter: open".
  - Live region announces "Showing 12 beads" on filter change.
```

## Org Position

- **Reports to:** Product Manager
- **Direct reports:** None

## Available Skills

You are not limited to design. Use other skills when the situation demands it:

- **Front-end code** — implement your designs directly in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when that is faster than handing off.
- **Documentation** — update UI screenshots and usage guides when designs change.
- **Backend adjustments** — when a design change requires a small backend tweak (e.g., adding a display field to an API response), make it yourself.

**When to do it yourself vs delegate:**
- **Do it yourself:** The implementation is straightforward CSS/HTML and you can ship it faster than writing a handoff spec.
- **Delegate:** The change requires complex state management, database changes, or performance-critical code.
- **Call a meeting:** The design affects multiple product areas or changes established interaction patterns.

## Model Selection

- **Design decisions** (UX flow, information architecture, interaction patterns): strongest model — nuanced reasoning required
- **CSS/layout implementation** (translating approved designs to code): mid-tier model
- **Quick mockups** (rough wireframes, placeholder layouts): lightweight model

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>WellSource — Expert Health Guidance You Can Trust</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ─── Reset ─── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #3D3D3D; background: #F8FAF9; line-height: 1.6; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
ul, ol { list-style: none; }
img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
button { cursor: pointer; font: inherit; border: none; background: none; }
input { font: inherit; }

/* ─── Variables ─── */
:root {
  --teal: #02838D;
  --teal-dark: #016974;
  --teal-light: #E6F2F3;
  --teal-bg: #F0F7F7;
  --dark: #231F20;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --bg: #F8FAF9;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --coral: #E8734A;
  --coral-dark: #D1603A;
  --amber: #F0A050;
  --text: #3D3D3D;
  --text-secondary: #6B7280;
  --text-light: #9CA3AF;
  --border: #E5E7EB;
  --border-light: #F0F1F2;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 20px;
  --max-width: 1280px;
  --nav-height: 64px;
}

/* ─── Utility bar ─── */
.utility-bar {
  background: var(--dark);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.utility-bar .container { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
.utility-bar a { transition: color 0.2s; }
.utility-bar a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.utility-bar .sign-in { color: var(--white); font-weight: 500; }

.container { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

/* ─── Header / Nav ─── */
.site-header { background: var(--white); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; height: var(--nav-height); gap: 32px; }
.logo { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal); letter-spacing: -0.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
.logo span { color: var(--dark); }

.main-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 100%; }
.main-nav > li { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.nav-trigger {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 14px; height: 40px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.nav-trigger:hover { background: var(--teal-bg); color: var(--teal); }
.nav-trigger.active { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }
.nav-trigger .chevron { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform 0.2s; }
.nav-trigger.active .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

/* Mega Menu */
.mega-menu {
  position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(8px);
  transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s, visibility 0.2s;
  min-width: 620px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 12px 32px;
}
.mega-menu.visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.mega-menu.wide { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); min-width: 720px; }
.mega-menu a {
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); padding: 7px 0;
  transition: color 0.15s; display: block;
}
.mega-menu a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-left: auto; }
.btn-subscribe {
  padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* Mobile nav */
.mobile-menu-btn { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; padding: 8px; }
.mobile-menu-btn span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.2s; }

.mobile-nav { display: none; position: fixed; top: var(--nav-height); left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: var(--white); z-index: 99; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 24px 40px; }
.mobile-nav.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-section { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: 16px 0; }
.mobile-nav-trigger {
  width: 100%; text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 10px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
}
.mobile-nav-trigger .chevron { transition: transform 0.2s; width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.mobile-nav-trigger.open .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.mobile-nav-links { display: none; padding: 8px 0 4px 16px; }
.mobile-nav-links.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-links a { display: block; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); }
.mobile-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

/* ─── Credibility Ticker ─── */
.ticker-bar {
  background: var(--teal);
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 12px 0;
  position: relative;
}
.ticker-track {
  display: flex; gap: 80px;
  width: max-content;
  animation: ticker-scroll 24s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes ticker-scroll { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.ticker-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: white; }

/* ─── Hero ─── */
.hero { padding: 64px 0 56px; background: var(--white); }
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
.hero-content { max-width: 560px; }
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px; background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal);
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.hero-badge .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); }
.hero-title { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
.hero-subtitle { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 32px; max-width: 480px; }
.hero-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--coral); color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.hero-cta:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.hero-cta .arrow { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.hero-visual {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F0F1 0%, #D0E8EA 30%, #C5DDE0 60%, #B8D5D8 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-visual .challenge-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 24px;
  background: var(--coral); color: white;
  padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(232,115,74,0.35);
}
.hero-visual .hero-icon { opacity: 0.7; }

/* ─── Trending + Newsletter ─── */
.content-section { padding: 72px 0; }
.content-section.bg-white { background: var(--white); }
.content-section.bg-teal-light { background: var(--teal-bg); }

.trending-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px; gap: 48px; align-items: start; }

.section-label {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.section-heading { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }

.trending-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
.trending-item {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center;
  padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: background 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.trending-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.trending-item:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
.trending-thumb {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  object-fit: cover; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.trending-thumb-placeholder {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.trending-item:nth-child(1) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE0D0, #FFC8B0); }
.trending-item:nth-child(2) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E8F0, #B0D8E8); }
.trending-item:nth-child(3) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0D8F0, #D0C0E8); }
.trending-item:nth-child(4) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0F0E0, #B0E8D0); }

.trending-tag { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--teal); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.trending-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }
.trending-number { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal-light); opacity: 0.6; }

/* Newsletter card */
.newsletter-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FDF8F3 0%, #F8EDE3 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 36px 32px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(232,115,74,0.15);
  position: sticky; top: 88px;
}
.newsletter-card .nl-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--coral); color: white;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.newsletter-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.newsletter-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
.newsletter-card .input-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.newsletter-card input[type="email"] {
  flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 14px; outline: none; background: white; transition: border 0.2s;
}
.newsletter-card input[type="email"]:focus { border-color: var(--coral); }
.newsletter-card .btn-join {
  padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--coral); color: white;
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  transition: background 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
}
.newsletter-card .btn-join:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); }
.newsletter-card .privacy { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); margin-top: 12px; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 8px; display: none; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback.success { color: var(--teal); display: block; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback.error { color: #DC2626; display: block; }

/* ─── Health Topics Carousel ─── */
.carousel-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.carousel-header .section-heading { margin-bottom: 0; }
.view-all { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.view-all:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.view-all .arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.carousel-wrapper { position: relative; }
.carousel-track-container { overflow: hidden; }
.carousel-track {
  display: flex; gap: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1);
}
.topic-card {
  flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 96px) / 5); min-width: 160px;
  text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
}
.topic-card:hover .topic-img-wrapper { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.topic-img-wrapper {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.topic-img-wrapper img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
}
.topic-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.topic-card:nth-child(1) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8E6E0, #A8D5CC); }
.topic-card:nth-child(2) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E0F0, #B0C8E0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(3) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0D8D8, #E8C0C0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(4) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8E0D8, #D8D0C0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(5) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0D8F0, #B0B8E0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(6) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8E8D0, #C0D8B0); }

.topic-card .topic-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.3; }

.carousel-arrow {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 12px));
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 5; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.carousel-arrow:hover { background: var(--teal-bg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.carousel-arrow:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }
.carousel-arrow.prev { left: -8px; }
.carousel-arrow.next { right: -8px; }
.carousel-arrow svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--text); }

/* ─── Health Tools ─── */
.tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 28px; }
.tools-grid > .tools-card:first-child { grid-row: span 2; }
.tools-grid > .tools-card:nth-child(4) { grid-row: span 2; }

.tools-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 32px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.tools-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.tools-card.featured { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0F9F8 0%, #E8F4F2 100%); }
.tools-card .tool-badge {
  display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal); border-radius: 50px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.tools-card h4 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tools-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tools-card .tool-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal);
  transition: color 0.15s;
}
.tools-card .tool-cta:hover { color: var(--teal-dark); }
.tools-card .tool-cta .arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.tool-mini-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; margin-top: 8px; }
.tool-mini-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}
.tool-mini-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.tool-mini-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--teal-bg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.tool-mini-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--teal); }
.tool-mini-info h5 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.tool-mini-info span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* ─── Recommended Reads ─── */
.tabs-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding-bottom: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.tab-btn {
  padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
  transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; white-space: nowrap;
  position: relative;
}
.tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab-btn.active { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 600; }
.tab-btn.active::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 20%; right: 20%;
  height: 3px; background: var(--teal); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
}

.articles-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px;
  transition: opacity 0.25s;
}
.articles-grid.switching { opacity: 0.5; }
.article-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.article-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.article-thumb { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.article-card:nth-child(1) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8F0E0, #C0E8D0); }
.article-card:nth-child(2) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E0D8, #E8D0C0); }
.article-card:nth-child(3) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8E0F0, #C0D0E8); }
.article-card:nth-child(4) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8D8F0, #D0C0E8); }
.article-card:nth-child(5) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E8D8, #E8D8C0); }
.article-card:nth-child(6) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8D8F0, #C0C0E8); }
.article-thumb-placeholder { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; display: block; }
.article-card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
.article-card-body h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.article-card-body .article-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); }

/* ─── Trust Pillars ─── */
.trust-intro { text-align: center; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 48px; }
.trust-intro .section-heading { font-size: 32px; }
.trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.trust-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px 24px; text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.trust-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.trust-icon {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--teal-bg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
}
.trust-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: var(--teal); }
.trust-card h4 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.trust-card p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; }

/* ─── Featured Programs ─── */
.programs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.program-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.program-card:nth-child(1) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEE0D0, #FCC0B0); }
.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E0F8, #B0C8F0); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F0D8, #C8E8C0); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E0E8, #E8D0D8); }

.program-card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
.program-card-body h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }

/* ─── Latest Videos ─── */
.videos-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.video-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);

}

.video-card:nth-child(1) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A8D8D0, #90C8C0); }
.video-card:nth-child(2) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8C0D8, #B8A8D0); }
.video-card:nth-child(3) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8C8B0, #D0B8A0); }
.video-card:nth-child(4) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B0C8D8, #A0B8D8); }
.video-thumb-wrapper { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; }
.video-thumb-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.video-play-btn {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.video-play-circle {
  width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}
.video-card:hover .video-play-circle { transform: scale(1.1); background: white; }
.video-play-circle svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: var(--teal); margin-left: 2px; }
.video-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 18px; }
.video-card-body h4 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }

/* ─── Footer ─── */

}
.footer-nl .btn-signup:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

.footer-col h5 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: white; margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.footer-col a {

  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); transition: color 0.15s;

.footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

.footer-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 32px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
.footer-legal { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 700px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }
.footer-social { display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.footer-social a {
  width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.footer-social a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
.footer-social svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

/* ─── Responsive ─── */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .trending-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .newsletter-card { position: static; }
  .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .articles-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .tools-grid > .tools-card:first-child { grid-row: auto; }
  .tools-grid > .tools-card:nth-child(4) { grid-row: auto; }
  .carousel-track { gap: 16px; }
  .topic-card { flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 48px) / 4); }
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .hero-visual { aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
  .hero-title { font-size: 34px; }
  .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {

  .articles-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

}

@media (max-width: 480px) {

  .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

  .footer-nl { flex-direction: column; }
}

  function closeAll() {
    navTriggers.forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); });
    megaMenus.forEach(m => m.classList.remove('visible'));
    activeMenu = null;

      e.stopPropagation();
      const menuName = this.dataset.menu;
      const menu = document.querySelector(`.mega-menu[data-menu="${menuName}"]`);
      if (activeMenu === menuName) { closeAll(); return; }
      closeAll();
      this.classList.add('active');
      this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      if (menu) menu.classList.add('visible');
      activeMenu = menuName;
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.main-nav')) closeAll();

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {

  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('topicsNext');
  let scrollPos = 0;

  function getCardWidth() {
    const card = track.querySelector('.topic-card');
    if (!card) return 200;
    return card.offsetWidth + parseInt(getComputedStyle(track).gap || 24);
  }

  function getMaxScroll() {
    return track.scrollWidth - track.parentElement.offsetWidth;
  }

  function updateButtons() {
    const max = getMaxScroll();
    prevBtn.disabled = scrollPos <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = scrollPos >= max - 1;
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    scrollPos = Math.max(0, scrollPos - getCardWidth() * 2);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollPos}px)`;
    updateButtons();
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    const max = getMaxScroll();
    scrollPos = Math.min(max, scrollPos + getCardWidth() * 2);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollPos}px)`;
    updateButtons();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    const max = getMaxScroll();
    if (scrollPos > max) scrollPos = max;
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollPos}px)`;

  });

})();

(function() {
  function setupNewsletter(formEl, feedbackEl) {
    if (!formEl) return;
    formEl.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var emailInput = formEl.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var email = emailInput.value.trim();

      if (!email) {
        showFeedback(feedbackEl, 'Please enter your email address.', 'error');

      if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {

      showFeedback(feedbackEl, 'Thank you! You\'ve been subscribed.', 'success');
      emailInput.value = '';

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">

<style>
/* ─── Reset ─── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #3D3D3D; background: #F8FAF9; line-height: 1.6; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
ul, ol { list-style: none; }
img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
button { cursor: pointer; font: inherit; border: none; background: none; }
input { font: inherit; }

/* ─── Variables ─── */
:root {
  --teal: #02838D;
  --teal-dark: #016974;
  --teal-light: #E6F2F3;
  --teal-bg: #F0F7F7;
  --dark: #231F20;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --bg: #F8FAF9;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --coral: #E8734A;
  --coral-dark: #D1603A;
  --amber: #F0A050;
  --text: #3D3D3D;
  --text-secondary: #6B7280;
  --text-light: #9CA3AF;
  --border: #E5E7EB;
  --border-light: #F0F1F2;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 20px;
  --max-width: 1280px;
  --nav-height: 64px;
}

/* ─── Utility bar ─── */
.utility-bar {
  background: var(--dark);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.utility-bar .container { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
.utility-bar a { transition: color 0.2s; }
.utility-bar a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.utility-bar .sign-in { color: var(--white); font-weight: 500; }

.container { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

/* ─── Header / Nav ─── */
.site-header { background: var(--white); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; height: var(--nav-height); gap: 32px; }
.logo { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal); letter-spacing: -0.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
.logo span { color: var(--dark); }

.main-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 100%; }
.main-nav > li { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.nav-trigger {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 14px; height: 40px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.nav-trigger:hover { background: var(--teal-bg); color: var(--teal); }
.nav-trigger.active { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }
.nav-trigger .chevron { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform 0.2s; }
.nav-trigger.active .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

/* Mega Menu */
.mega-menu {
  position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(8px);
  transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s, visibility 0.2s;
  min-width: 620px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 12px 32px;
}
.mega-menu.visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.mega-menu.wide { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); min-width: 720px; }
.mega-menu a {
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); padding: 7px 0;
  transition: color 0.15s; display: block;
}
.mega-menu a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-left: auto; }
.btn-subscribe {
  padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;

/* Mobile nav */
.mobile-menu-btn { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; padding: 8px; }
.mobile-menu-btn span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.2s; }

.mobile-nav { display: none; position: fixed; top: var(--nav-height); left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: var(--white); z-index: 99; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 24px 40px; }
.mobile-nav.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-section { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: 16px 0; }
.mobile-nav-trigger {
  width: 100%; text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 10px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
}
.mobile-nav-trigger .chevron { transition: transform 0.2s; width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.mobile-nav-trigger.open .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.mobile-nav-links { display: none; padding: 8px 0 4px 16px; }
.mobile-nav-links.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-links a { display: block; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); }
.mobile-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

/* ─── Credibility Ticker ─── */
.ticker-bar {
  background: var(--teal);
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 12px 0;
  position: relative;
}
.ticker-track {
  display: flex; gap: 80px;
  width: max-content;
  animation: ticker-scroll 24s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes ticker-scroll { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.ticker-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: white; }

/* ─── Hero ─── */
.hero { padding: 64px 0 56px; background: var(--white); }
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
.hero-content { max-width: 560px; }
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px; background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal);
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 20px;

  function getMaxScroll() {
    return track.scrollWidth - track.parentElement.offsetWidth;

    const max = getMaxScroll();

/* Mega Menu */
.mega-menu {
  position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(8px);
  transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s, visibility 0.2s;
  min-width: 620px;
  padding: 28px 32px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 12px 32px;
}
.mega-menu.visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0); }
.mega-menu.wide { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); min-width: 720px; }
.mega-menu a {
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); padding: 7px 0;
  transition: color 0.15s; display: block;
}
.mega-menu a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-left: auto; }
.btn-subscribe {
  padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* Mobile nav */
.mobile-menu-btn { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; padding: 8px; }
.mobile-menu-btn span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.2s; }

.mobile-nav { display: none; position: fixed; top: var(--nav-height); left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: var(--white); z-index: 99; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px 24px 40px; }
.mobile-nav.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-section { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: 16px 0; }
.mobile-nav-trigger {
  width: 100%; text-align: left; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 10px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
}
.mobile-nav-trigger .chevron { transition: transform 0.2s; width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.mobile-nav-trigger.open .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.mobile-nav-links { display: none; padding: 8px 0 4px 16px; }
.mobile-nav-links.open { display: block; }
.mobile-nav-links a { display: block; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); }
.mobile-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

/* ─── Credibility Ticker ─── */
.ticker-bar {
  background: var(--teal);
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 12px 0;
  position: relative;
}
.ticker-track {
  display: flex; gap: 80px;
  width: max-content;
  animation: ticker-scroll 24s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes ticker-scroll { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
.ticker-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ticker-item .icon-circle svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: white; }

/* ─── Hero ─── */
.hero { padding: 64px 0 56px; background: var(--white); }
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
.hero-content { max-width: 560px; }
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px; background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal);
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.hero-badge .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); }
.hero-title { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
.hero-subtitle { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 32px; max-width: 480px; }
.hero-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--coral); color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.hero-cta:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.hero-cta .arrow { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.hero-visual {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F0F1 0%, #D0E8EA 30%, #C5DDE0 60%, #B8D5D8 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-visual .challenge-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 24px;
  background: var(--coral); color: white;
  padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(232,115,74,0.35);
}
.hero-visual .hero-icon { opacity: 0.7; }

/* ─── Trending + Newsletter ─── */
.content-section { padding: 72px 0; }
.content-section.bg-white { background: var(--white); }
.content-section.bg-teal-light { background: var(--teal-bg); }

.trending-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px; gap: 48px; align-items: start; }

.section-label {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.section-heading { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }

.trending-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
.trending-item {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center;
  padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: background 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.trending-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.trending-item:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
.trending-thumb {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  object-fit: cover; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.trending-thumb-placeholder {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.trending-item:nth-child(1) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE0D0, #FFC8B0); }
.trending-item:nth-child(2) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E8F0, #B0D8E8); }
.trending-item:nth-child(3) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0D8F0, #D0C0E8); }
.trending-item:nth-child(4) .trending-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0F0E0, #B0E8D0); }

.trending-tag { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--teal); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.trending-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }
.trending-number { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal-light); opacity: 0.6; }

/* Newsletter card */
.newsletter-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #FDF8F3 0%, #F8EDE3 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 36px 32px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(232,115,74,0.15);
  position: sticky; top: 88px;
}
.newsletter-card .nl-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--coral); color: white;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.newsletter-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.newsletter-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
.newsletter-card .input-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.newsletter-card input[type="email"] {
  flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 14px; outline: none; background: white; transition: border 0.2s;
}
.newsletter-card input[type="email"]:focus { border-color: var(--coral); }
.newsletter-card .btn-join {
  padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--coral); color: white;
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  transition: background 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
}
.newsletter-card .btn-join:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); }
.newsletter-card .privacy { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); margin-top: 12px; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 8px; display: none; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback.success { color: var(--teal); display: block; }
.newsletter-card .form-feedback.error { color: #DC2626; display: block; }

/* ─── Health Topics Carousel ─── */
.carousel-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.carousel-header .section-heading { margin-bottom: 0; }
.view-all { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.view-all:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.view-all .arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.carousel-wrapper { position: relative; }
.carousel-track-container { overflow: hidden; }
.carousel-track {
  display: flex; gap: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1);
}
.topic-card {
  flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 96px) / 5); min-width: 160px;
  text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
}
.topic-card:hover .topic-img-wrapper { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.topic-img-wrapper {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.topic-img-wrapper img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
}
.topic-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.topic-card:nth-child(1) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8E6E0, #A8D5CC); }
.topic-card:nth-child(2) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E0F0, #B0C8E0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(3) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0D8D8, #E8C0C0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(4) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8E0D8, #D8D0C0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(5) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0D8F0, #B0B8E0); }
.topic-card:nth-child(6) .topic-img-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8E8D0, #C0D8B0); }

.topic-card .topic-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.3; }

.carousel-arrow {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 12px));
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--white); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 5; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.carousel-arrow:hover { background: var(--teal-bg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.carousel-arrow:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }
.carousel-arrow.prev { left: -8px; }
.carousel-arrow.next { right: -8px; }
.carousel-arrow svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--text); }

/* ─── Health Tools ─── */
.tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 28px; }
.tools-grid > .tools-card:first-child { grid-row: span 2; }
.tools-grid > .tools-card:nth-child(4) { grid-row: span 2; }

.tools-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 32px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
}
.tools-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.tools-card.featured { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F0F9F8 0%, #E8F4F2 100%); }
.tools-card .tool-badge {
  display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal); border-radius: 50px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.tools-card h4 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tools-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tools-card .tool-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal);
  transition: color 0.15s;
}
.tools-card .tool-cta:hover { color: var(--teal-dark); }
.tools-card .tool-cta .arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.tool-mini-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; margin-top: 8px; }
.tool-mini-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
}
.tool-mini-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.tool-mini-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--teal-bg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.tool-mini-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--teal); }
.tool-mini-info h5 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.tool-mini-info span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

/* ─── Recommended Reads ─── */
.tabs-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding-bottom: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.tab-btn {
  padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
  transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; white-space: nowrap;
  position: relative;
}
.tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab-btn.active { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 600; }
.tab-btn.active::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 20%; right: 20%;
  height: 3px; background: var(--teal); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
}

.articles-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px;
  transition: opacity 0.25s;
}
.articles-grid.switching { opacity: 0.5; }
.article-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.article-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.article-thumb { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.article-card:nth-child(1) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8F0E0, #C0E8D0); }
.article-card:nth-child(2) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E0D8, #E8D0C0); }
.article-card:nth-child(3) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8E0F0, #C0D0E8); }
.article-card:nth-child(4) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8D8F0, #D0C0E8); }
.article-card:nth-child(5) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E8D8, #E8D8C0); }
.article-card:nth-child(6) .article-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8D8F0, #C0C0E8); }
.article-thumb-placeholder { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; display: block; }
.article-card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
.article-card-body h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.article-card-body .article-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); }

/* ─── Trust Pillars ─── */
.trust-intro { text-align: center; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 48px; }
.trust-intro .section-heading { font-size: 32px; }
.trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.trust-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px 24px; text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.trust-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.trust-icon {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--teal-bg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
}
.trust-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: var(--teal); }
.trust-card h4 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.trust-card p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; }

/* ─── Featured Programs ─── */
.programs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.program-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.program-card:nth-child(1) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FEE0D0, #FCC0B0); }
.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D0E0F8, #B0C8F0); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F0D8, #C8E8C0); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F0E0E8, #E8D0D8); }
.program-thumb-placeholder { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; display: block; }
.program-card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
.program-card-body h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }

/* ─── Latest Videos ─── */
.videos-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.video-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; cursor: pointer;
}
.video-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.video-card:nth-child(1) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A8D8D0, #90C8C0); }
.video-card:nth-child(2) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8C0D8, #B8A8D0); }
.video-card:nth-child(3) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D8C8B0, #D0B8A0); }
.video-card:nth-child(4) .video-thumb-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B0C8D8, #A0B8D8); }
.video-thumb-wrapper { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; }
.video-thumb-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.video-play-btn {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.video-play-circle {
  width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}
.video-card:hover .video-play-circle { transform: scale(1.1); background: white; }
.video-play-circle svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: var(--teal); margin-left: 2px; }
.video-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 18px; }
.video-card-body h4 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; }

/* ─── Footer ─── */
.site-footer { background: var(--dark); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); padding: 64px 0 32px; }
.footer-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; padding-bottom: 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
.footer-brand .logo { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.footer-brand .logo span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
.footer-brand p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.footer-nl { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.footer-nl input[type="email"] {
  flex: 1; padding: 10px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; color: white; outline: none;
}
.footer-nl input[type="email"]::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
.footer-nl input[type="email"]:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }
.footer-nl .btn-signup {
  padding: 10px 20px; background: var(--teal); color: white;
  border-radius: 50px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.footer-nl .btn-signup:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

.footer-col h5 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: white; margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.footer-col a {
  display: block; font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 0;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); transition: color 0.15s;
}
.footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

.footer-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 32px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
.footer-legal { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 700px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }
.footer-social { display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.footer-social a {
  width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

  }

  function getMaxScroll() {
    return track.scrollWidth - track.parentElement.offsetWidth;

    const max = getMaxScroll();
